title: Friday at Two
style: Progressive house with upbeat four-on-the-floor pulse, bouncy offbeat bass, bright piano stabs, and rising synth arps; verse rides tight drums and minimal chords, pre-chorus lifts with filtered pads and a snare build, chorus opens wide with stacked gang vocals and a lifted lead melody. Breathy close-mic verse vocal, doubled hook lines, short delay throws on key words, sparkling risers and reverse swells into each drop, bright punchy glossy mix., soft, progressive house, clean, simple, happy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ricardo the Doctor Mechanic is coming through
Friday at 2 PM, he’s coming to see Corey
FJ45 needs work, he’s ready to start
Tyler, if you come too, he can go straight from the start
No waiting around, get it done in one go
Ricardo at the spot, ready with the quote
Brakes on the truck, that’s the first thing to fix
Before you head up that steep hill to the house

[Pre-Chorus]
Friday at 2, that’s the plan
Tyler, come through, lend a hand
Soft on the pedal, don’t take the chance
Get it done now, while you can

[Chorus]
Friday at 2, Ricardo coming through
He’s coming to Corey, Tyler you should too
Viernes a las dos, el doctor va a llegar
Tyler come through so the work can start
Fix the brakes first, before that steep hill
Don’t risk the drive when the pedal don’t feel
Ricardo at 2, he’s ready to go
Tyler, just show so the work can flow

[Verse 2]
Quote is already done, six hundred for the full
Parts and labor ready, everything in the pull
Ricardo knows the FJ, he did the inspection
Friday at 2, that’s the confirmed direction
Tyler, if you’re there, he can start right away
No time wasted, get it moving the same day
Brakes feeling soft, that’s the danger zone
Fix it before you drive that hill back home

[Pre-Chorus]
Friday at 2, that’s the cue
Corey, Tyler, see it through
When the truck is set and the work is real
You can roll out clean on that steep hill

[Chorus]
Friday at 2, Ricardo coming through
He’s coming to Corey, Tyler you should too
Viernes a las dos, el doctor va a llegar
Tyler come through so the work can start
Fix the brakes first, before that steep hill
Don’t risk the drive when the pedal don’t feel
Ricardo at 2, he’s ready to go
Tyler, just show so the work can flow

[Bridge]
Friday at 2, pull up on time
Corey at the spot, Tyler right behind
Simple and clear, keep it moving right
Safe on the road when the brakes feel tight

[Chorus]
Friday at 2, Ricardo coming through
He’s coming to Corey, Tyler you should too
Viernes a las dos, el doctor va a llegar
Tyler come through so the work can start
Fix the brakes first, before that steep hill
Don’t risk the drive when the pedal don’t feel
Ricardo at 2, he’s ready to go
Tyler, just show so the work can flow

[Outro]
Friday at 2, Ricardo on site
Tyler come through, everything will be right
Fix the brakes first, then handle the rest
Simple and clear, that’s what’s best
